in_hebrew.name: בַטֶלְדָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Bathelda is derived from the Hebrew words 'bat' (daughter) and 'helda' (fortress, stronghold). This name conveys the meaning 'God is my fortress', emphasizing the idea of protection and security in the Lord.

in_greek.name: Βαθελδα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Bathelda is derived from the Greek words 'bathos' (depth) and 'hilasthenai' (to make clean, purify). This name means 'Stronghold of God', suggesting a deep and abiding faith in the divine protection and purification.

in_latin.name: Bathelda
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Bathelda is a translation of the Greek name, and it means 'God's stronghold'. This name reflects the idea of trusting in the strength and protection of God.
